page_title: PDFSail - Free Online PDF Editor, Converter & Merger

sources.entry: PDFsail - All-in-one PDF tool for editing, converting, merging, compressing, and OCR.

summary.name: PDFSail
summary.one_liner: PDFSail is a free online PDF editor, converter, and merger that runs many tools locally in the browser, with optional paid Pro features for advanced processing.
use_cases: Compress a PDF for email or upload
Merge several PDFs into one document
Redact sensitive text in a PDF
Convert a scanned PDF into searchable text
Convert a PDF into an editable Word document
Extract tables from PDF into spreadsheet rows
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an online PDF toolset covering conversion, compression, merging, splitting, editing, signing, redaction, page numbering, watermarking, and password removal. Basic tasks such as compression, merging, splitting, annotations, and basic editing are stated to run locally in the browser using WebAssembly without an account or upload. Advanced features such as high-fidelity PDF-to-Office conversion, OCR, batch processing, and large document workflows are described as part of the paid Pro offering that uses cloud resources. The page also lists multi-step workflows and conversions from Apple Pages, Numbers, Keynote, and AutoCAD files.
notable: Core PDF tasks run locally in the browser via WebAssembly, with files stated to never leave the computer
No account required for basic tools
Advanced features such as OCR, high-fidelity conversion, and batch processing are behind optional Pro features
caveats: OCR, high-fidelity PDF-to-Office conversion, batch processing, and large document workflows require paid Pro features
A Corporate License is mentioned at $19/yr for formal tax receipts or compliance certification
Page mentions a free daily quota but does not state its limits
